faqs.q: How do I apply for or manage a bus driver authority?
faqs.a: You can apply for a bus driver authority, renew it online, replace a lost or damaged one, or change the details on your existing authority.

faqs.q: How do I register or renew a public passenger vehicle?
faqs.a: You can register a public passenger vehicle or renew the registration for a public passenger vehicle or heavy vehicle (without an HVIS inspection).

faqs.q: What services are available for taxis?
faqs.a: You can manage your taxi licence, renew a taxi registration, book a wheelchair accessible taxi, find a secure taxi rank, or report a taxi.

faqs.q: How do I apply for a passenger transport licence code?
faqs.a: Information is available regarding the application for a passenger transport licence code.
